# SFCC-89 — PDP static product information, built fresh

**Planned 2026-08-23.** Nothing built yet; no branch cut.

---

## Context

SFCC-89 ("PDP UI — static product information") already has an attempt on PR #57, by Jhoan. Its
component layer is good — `ZimmPdpProductInfo` is the best worked example of the house styling
pattern in the repo. Its integration layer is not: the page override takes over
`/product/:productId` and renders only a static panel, so **merging it removes add-to-bag, swatches,
the quantity picker, recommendations, accordions, SEO tags and 404 handling from the live PDP.**

That traces to one skipped step — the copy-first rule — which is also why its breadcrumb silently
restyled the PLP. Rebuilding correctly is cleaner than unpicking it.

Outcome wanted: SFCC-89's acceptance criteria delivered on top of an **untouched out-of-the-box
PDP**, with the genuinely shared pieces extracted as atoms that SFCC-91/92/194 can import.

---

## Decisions locked

| # | Decision |
|---|---|
| 1 | Branch **`feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info`**, cut from `develop` now, rebased when **PR #59** lands. |
| 2 | Clean build. #57 and SFCC-91 are read as reference so we don't build blindly — never copied from. |
| 3 | **Copy-first the PDP page.** Non-negotiable; its absence caused every integration defect in #57. |
| 4 | **`product-view` gets one override with a single optional `renderHeader` prop**, defaulting to the existing private header, so cart/wishlist/bonus-product are byte-identical unless they opt in. No speculative slots for SFCC-91/92. |
| 5 | Treat `overrides/app/components/product-view/` as **Tier 2**; notify Squad B before the PR. If sign-off outruns the sprint, proceed on the verified-approver path. |
| 6 | Model line reads **`c_modelFit`** and renders nothing when absent. No `c_sizeFit` scraping. |
| 7 | **Sanitiser: reproduce or refute the SSR crash first — hard gate.** No component code until it resolves. |
| 8 | **The page composes.** No container component mirroring `pdp/product-content`; the ported page places the pieces. |
| 9 | Page layout values as **Chakra props on the page**, not a recipe — `overrideStyling.md`'s recipe tier is scoped to variant/state on non-Chakra props, and a grid has no states. |
| 10 | Unresolved values get a **named const + comment** stating the measured value, the missing token and the owner. |
| 11 | **Recipes only where a variant or state exists.** |
| 12 | Test shape follows **PR #59**, plus the six gap closures below. |
| 13 | PR #57 stays open, closes as superseded once ours delivers. |
| 14 | `testing.md`'s `:42` wording fix deferred until after this ships. |
| 15 | The atom/molecule/organism taxonomy stays **informal** — it exists only in directory names and #59's practice, not in any repo rule. No rules PR. |

---

## Scope

**In:** product name · price · description · style code · model line · the page port.

**Out, with owners:**

| Item | Owner |
|---|---|
| **Breadcrumb** | **SFCC-578** (Squad B) — no design exists anywhere; see findings |
| Disclaimer band | **SFCC-749** / **SFCC-748** (Isabel, Squad A, epic SFCC-3) |
| Colour swatches | SFCC-91 |
| Size selector, add-to-bag | SFCC-92 |
| Image gallery | SFCC-186/187/188 |
| Accordions | SFCC-195/102/267/266 |
| Badges | SFCC-132/225 · Was/now pricing | SFCC-194 · Wishlist | SFCC-434 |
| Find in Boutique | SFCC-297 |

---

## What we build

Only two things earn their own file. A thing earns one when it has **its own reason to change** —
used in more than one place · has variants or states · owns a rule that must live in one place ·
has logic worth testing in isolation. Citable: `conventions.md` (*"extract … once the same pattern
appears in two places"*, *"resist speculative abstractions"*), `components.md:25`, `components.md:105`.

| Thing | Verdict | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **`zimmProductPrice`** | atom + recipe | The only Figma *component* in scope (`pdp/price`, `state=Sale`/`Default`). Variants ⇒ recipe ⇒ registered name. SFCC-194 reuses it. |
| **`zimmProductProse`** | atom + recipe | The sanitiser boundary — `semgrep.yml` enforces it, so it lives in exactly one auditable place. Needs the mobile inset, hence a recipe. |
| Product name | **page markup** | `textStyle="heading3"` on an element. Not a Figma component. PDP cap-height 11 at 180px; PLP card cap-height 9 at 212px — different presentation, so not shared. Extract when a second consumer needs the *same* treatment. |
| Style code | **page markup** | Label + value, one consumer, no variants, no logic. |
| Model line | **page markup** | Plain text via `c_modelFit`. Routes through `zimmProductProse` only if the field turns out to be HTML — ask the BA. |

**No molecules. No organisms.** `pdp/hero` is the organism and it's SFCC-723's.

**Page layout values.** From `pdp/hero` Desktop Default (1440): gallery `list` x=0 w=**902**,
`pdp/product-content` x=**1082** w=**218** ⇒ gap **180**, right margin **140**.

| Value | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Column gap 180px | `var(--zimm-scale-4500)` — exact match, **not** a token gap |
| Desktop right pad 140px | `var(--zimm-scale-3500)` — exact match |
| Info column 218px | named const — no numeric alias for 218 |
| Mobile gutter 30px | import `grid.containerPadding.base` (exactly 30px; `grid` isn't a registered scale). **Not** the 32px `2xl` token. Confirmed by the mobile design: 342px column at x=30 in a 402 frame |
| Top padding 16px | bare key `m` |
| Gallery aspect ratio | plain ratio literal |

Note in the PR that **SFCC-723 (`pdp/hero`) should absorb these** into the hero organism.

---

## Test coverage requirements

#59's pattern is the basis and it is sound: move logic out into hooks, utils and exported recipe
resolvers, unit-test it there, let Storybook `play` drive the component. `AGENTS.md:151`,
`code-quality/SKILL.md:95` and `new-component/SKILL.md:50` all permit `.test.ts` **or** `play`, and
Storybook interaction + a11y are **required checks** on `develop`, so a play-only component is
genuinely gated. Its gates ran and passed on `a207b9a`, the last commit touching `overrides/`.

**Close these six gaps that #59 leaves:**

| # | Gap | What we do |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | Nothing ties external data shape to props. A mis-keyed field falls to `?? ''` and renders empty — invisible to `play` and to axe. `testing.md:19` ranks data mapping first. | A co-located test for the product→props mapping: every field, including absent, asserting the right field reached the right prop. |
| G2 | Nothing asserts a recipe's declared `parts` match what the component *reads*. Drift ⇒ `__css={undefined}` ⇒ silently unstyled. | Assert `parts` ⊇ the part names the component consumes. Comparing `parts` to `baseStyle` keys is insufficient — renaming both stays green. |
| G3 | Props crossing composition boundaries are unchecked. | Assert any prop crossing more than one boundary reaches the leaf. |
| G4 | Vacuity — suites asserting "no offenders" pass on empty input. Only `recipeGuards.test.ts` guards this. | Any such suite of ours carries a self-test proving it collected something. Copy `recipeGuards.test.ts:168-174`. |
| G5 | #59 asserts focus-trap behaviour in both a hook test and a `play`, against `testing.md:3`. | One layer per behaviour; note the choice. |
| G6 | A skipped required check satisfies branch protection. Correct when only docs/tooling changed; a hole when source changed. | Before requesting review, verify the gates ran on **the last commit that touched testable source**, not merely on head. |

Concretely: the **sanitiser util** and both **recipes** get real Vitest files; the two **atoms** get
stories, with a `play` only where there's real behaviour or an a11y contract; the **page's data
mapping** gets the G1 test.

---

## Build sequence

### Phase 0 — the gate. No component code until this resolves.

**Reproduce or refute the SSR crash.** Serve `build/` and request a valid and an invalid SKU;
capture the server log.

Established: the `isomorphic-dompurify` **Node entry is compiled into `build/server-renderer.js`**
(its Proxy with `get`/`apply` traps is identifiable in the minified output) and `jsdom` is a
**production** dependency pulled in by that package. **Unverified: that it actually throws.** The
original trace names `main-server.js`, a **dev-server** artifact that doesn't exist in a production
build. jsdom is a Node library and webpack's node target keeps its requires intact, so it may work
fine — in which case the TDZ error has another cause.

- **If it throws:** the engine choice is forced, and Hard Rule #7 becomes a defect report to
  Integration rather than a permission request.
- **If it doesn't:** `isomorphic-dompurify` stands as SFCC-195 documents it, and the only open
  question is 10 MB of jsdom on the SSR path — a cold-start cost, not a correctness one.

**In parallel (non-code, ungated):** cut the branch · notify Squad B about the `product-view`
override · send the designer batch · raise the findings below with Jas.

### Phase 1 — copy-first, then stop

Copy base `pages/product-detail/index.jsx` → `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx`,
convert to TypeScript, add the temporary marker log, and verify the **full** PDP still works:
add-to-bag, swatches, quantity, gallery, accordions, recommendations, SEO tags in the served HTML,
bad SKU → 404. **Pause for testing before any functional change.** Same for `product-view` when the
header slot lands.

Everything after this is additive, so capability cannot be lost.

### Phase 2 — the two atoms

`ui-kits/atoms/{zimmProductPrice,zimmProductProse}/` — `index.tsx` + `index.stories.tsx`, each with
a recipe in `theme/components/`, registered in that folder's `index.ts`. Names must be
`Zimm`-prefixed: base SFCC registers its own recipes and `extendTheme` deep-merges on a key
collision. `recipeGuards.test.ts` enforces this automatically once #59 lands.

### Phase 3 — integrate

Place the atoms, the name and the style code in the ported page, at the design's positions. Remove
the copy-first markers. **Name every base behaviour deliberately changed in the PR body.**

---

## Verification

**Mechanical** — none is CI-gated, so all are honour-system and must actually be run:
`npx tsc --noEmit` · `npm run lint` (17 pre-existing Contentful errors; ours must add none) ·
`npx vitest run` · `npm run build` then `npm run test:max-file-size` (**vendor sits at 95.4% of
budget** — read the headroom, not the pass) · `npx test-storybook --ci` against a built Storybook.

**Parity — the check that matters.** Re-run Phase 1's checklist against the finished page: add-to-bag
completes · a swatch changes the variant · quantity works · the gallery renders **through
`proxyImageUrl`** (direct Demandware access is Cloudflare-WAF-blocked outside the CC network, so
without it real shoppers get a 403) · accordions open · all three recommendation rails render · SEO
tags present in the **served** HTML · unknown SKU returns **404**, not 200.

**Acceptance criteria**, against live SFCC data: name · single full price in storefront currency ·
description · style code (**master style number, not `product.id`**) · model copy present when
`c_modelFit` exists and cleanly absent when it doesn't.

**Before requesting review** — per G6, confirm the gates ran on the last commit touching testable
source.

---

## Critical files

**Create:** `ui-kits/atoms/{zimmProductPrice,zimmProductProse}/` ·
`theme/components/{zimmProductPrice,zimmProductProse}.ts` · `utils/sanitiseHtml.ts` + test ·
`pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (copy-first port) + its data-mapping test ·
`components/product-view/` (scoped override)

**Modify:** `theme/components/index.ts` (registration) · `types/` for any new `c_*` narrowing.
`routes.tsx` **only if** the port needs it — the base route already resolves to the base page, so an
explicit entry is probably unnecessary.

**Reuse, don't rebuild:** `utils/safeHref.ts` (#59) · `utils/sfccImage.ts`'s `proxyImageUrl()` ·
`iconSizes` from `theme/foundation` · base `Skeleton`/`Box`/`Text` · base
`app/components/seo` — **`react-helmet@6.1.0` is already installed** as a `retail-react-app`
dependency, so SEO needs no new package.

---

## Verified corrections — do not relitigate

- **One shadowing mechanism, not two.** The resolver only redirects imports *naming* a package in
  `extends`; base `routes.jsx:43` uses a relative `import('./pages/product-detail')`, so it is never
  redirected. Removing `overrides/app/routes.tsx:37-40` alone restores the base PDP.
- **`Skeleton height="var(--zimm-scale-*)"` is correct.** `theme/index.ts` registers `space` but not
  `sizes`, so a bare key on a sizing prop misresolves.
- **`frozenFiles.md` is correct about fonts on `develop`** — none, by licence. #59 brings
  self-hosting, which is the agreed approach. Until it merges, no type metric is visually verifiable.
- **Base `categoryUrlBuilder` ignores the locale argument** it's handed. No multi-site routing bug.
- **`@storybook/test` doesn't exist** on Storybook 10 — import from `storybook/test`.
  `.claude/rules/testing.md:87` is wrong.
- **PR #55 is closed; #59 is live** on the same branch. #55 had no fonts and 8 recipes; #59 has both
  fonts and 10.
- **`<Island>` is inert** — `config/default.js:40` sets `partialHydrationEnabled: false`.
- **The composition order differs from #57**: name → price → description → colour → size → CTAs →
  accordions → **model line → style code**. Model copy and style code sit at the **bottom**.

---

## Design-system findings

- `pdp/hero` and `pdp/product-content` are real DS components, four variants each. 218px info column
  confirmed three ways.
- Vertical rhythm: **20px** within the text group (= `spacing.l`), **28px** between blocks, **44px**
  after the content group.
- Product name is capped at **180px** in a 218px row, wishlist at x=194–218.
- **Only `Price` is a Figma component** in scope. Name, description, model copy and style code are
  `text` nodes inside `frame` containers.
- Desktop page gutter is **40px**, consistent across four components.
- **DS-versus-page inconsistencies** (both real, for the designer):
  - `Button Large` is **52** in the DS component, **50** in both composed pages.
  - `styleCode` is **two nodes** (label + value) in the DS, **one** in both composed pages
    (`"Style Code: 7300JS261"`). #57's concatenation matches the pages.

---

## Findings to raise

**1. AC-6 asks for a breadcrumb that was never designed.** Checked: the design system by name, both
PDP components, both PLP bars at both breakpoints, both non-archived PDP designs in full, and the
Footer. The only appearance is placeholder copy in the **Disclaimer's Contentful-driven title field**
(SFCC-749 gives its example as *"TERMS AND CONDITIONS"*) — and a breadcrumb is derived at runtime
from the category path, so it structurally cannot be that field. #57's `/` separator and uppercase
were copied from that placeholder, not from a spec. → **Jas**, with SFCC-578 as the owner.

**2. Duplicate scope, three instances, all created 17 Aug and all "In Refinement":**

| Built / building | Duplicate |
|---|---|
| SFCC-89 | SFCC-737 `pdp/product-content` |
| SFCC-89's breadcrumb | SFCC-578 SEO Breadcrumb (Squad B) |
| SFCC-55 / PR #59 footer | SFCC-750 Footer – PWA Kit Component |

Systemic decomposition drift, not three coincidences. Raise as a pattern. SFCC-749's description
also self-links instead of pointing at SFCC-748, suggesting a batch created without a review pass.

**3. No page server-renders on the PR-57 preview or the `test` tier** — every route returns HTTP 200
with a `loadable` fallback spinner. Pre-existing, storefront-wide, and it defeats the ≤2s p75 LCP
budget. Likely `ChunkExtractor`/`loadable-stats.json` wiring in `ssr.js` — **Tier 1, Integration
only, do not attempt.** Also means MRT preview is not a usable SSR smoke test. Unknown whether
`staging`/`prod` behave the same.

**4. Ownership contradiction on `pages/product-detail/`:** `CODEOWNERS:159` says Squad B;
`.claude/rules/squadA.md:4,34` says Squad A; `.claude/registry/pages.md:20` says Squad A / Tier 4.
Recorded 2026-07-09 and still open. CODEOWNERS is the enforced surface. **Output must be a commit to
one governance file.**

**5. Repo rules that are wrong or missing:** `testing.md:87`'s broken `@storybook/test` import ·
`overrideStyling.md` mandates `scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`, which doesn't exist ·
`.claude/rules/overrides.md` is cross-referenced but absent from `develop` (it exists on
`f2r-component-registry` and contains the override pre-flight that would have caught #57's defects)
· no i18n rule exists anywhere, on a project with 11 locales.

## Designer batch

Which node is canonical (five in circulation) · **Button 50 vs 52** (DS vs composed pages) ·
**style code one node or two** (DS vs composed pages) · the **28px** and **44px** gaps — keep or
tokenise · `FONT_REGULAR` vs `FONT_MEDIUM` for price and meta copy (#57's recipe flags this
correctly) · the **768–1279px band is undesigned** (DS has 402 and 1440 only) · `body2Strong`
letter-spacing points at −0.12px where Figma reads −0.14px and `letterSpacings['2xs']` already holds
−0.14px (Tier 1, no PDP consumer — batch it) · `#000000` vs `text.default` on two labels.

**The three things that took the longest to get right, and where they landed:**

The **breadcrumb** is out — its only appearance anywhere was placeholder copy in SFCC-749's Contentful-driven title field, and a runtime-derived crumb trail structurally cannot be a CMS-authored title. `zimmPageToolbar` went with it, since there's no bar for it to live in.

**Page layout** uses Chakra props, not a recipe, because `overrideStyling.md`'s recipe tier is explicitly scoped to variant/state on non-Chakra props. And two values I'd called token gaps — the 180px gap and 140px padding — turned out to be exact matches for existing numeric aliases. #57 had them right.

**Five findings to raise**, in the plan with owners: the AC-versus-design breadcrumb conflict, the three-instance duplicate-scope pattern, the storefront-wide server-rendering failure, the three-way ownership contradiction on `pages/product-detail/`, and four broken or missing repo rules.

**On my own reliability here:** I flipped four times on the breadcrumb and twice dismissed your disclaimer hypothesis from layer names before a screenshot showed you were right — and then over-corrected until your ticket search settled it. The pattern was reading metadata instead of looking, and asserting before verifying. Worth weighting that when the next confident claim arrives.

## The arc of this session

**We started with branch hygiene** — synced the three local branches that were behind (`f2r-component-registry` by 31 commits, the SFCC-89 branch and `review/SFCC-89` by 2 each), left the 14 stale `[gone]` ones alone as backups.

**Then you asked me to take over PR #57.** Five agents investigated in parallel: the Jira requirements, the Figma design, the branch's code, the review state, and the existing PDP surface.

**What that found:**

| | |
|---|---|
| The ticket | 5 points, Sprint 3, due **17 Aug** — six days overdue at the time. AC lives in a custom field, easy to miss. Reporter Jasmijn, assignee Jhoan |
| The PR | 30 files, +1702/−99. `CHANGES_REQUESTED` — **entirely by CodeRabbit. No human had reviewed it.** Five reviewer teams requested, none responded in four days |
| The blocker nobody had named | The page override takes over `/product/:productId` and renders only a static panel. **Merging removes add-to-bag, swatches, quantity, recommendations, accordions, SEO and 404 handling from the live PDP** |
| Second unflagged defect | The breadcrumb sits at a path that shadows a shared SFCC module, so it silently restyled the **PLP** |
| Governance | `isomorphic-dompurify` added to Tier 1 `package.json` with no approval — and the PR body itself names the rule it was breaking |
| Verification | `tsc` clean, Vitest 146/146 and Storybook 27/27 genuinely ran. **`npm run lint` fails with 5 errors on this branch** while the PR body ticks it as passing |

**Then you had me run all that against your four local docs** — four agents, one per doc, plus a fifth to reconcile them. That produced the takeover report at `~/Dev/SFCC-89_PR57-takeover-report.md`, which I then rewrote in plainer language when the first version read like an audit trail.

**That investigation also turned up something bigger than the PR:** no page on this storefront server-renders. Every route on the preview and the `test` tier returns HTTP 200 with a loading spinner. Pre-existing, storefront-wide, Tier 1, Integration's.

**Then you chose to rebuild rather than repair**, with planning done properly first. That's the last few hours.

---

## What we settled

**Build fresh** on `feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info`, cut from `develop` now, rebased when **PR #59** lands. #57 and SFCC-91 are read as reference, never copied from.

**Copy-first the page.** Non-negotiable — its absence caused every integration defect in #57.

**`product-view` gets one override** with a single optional `renderHeader` prop defaulting to base behaviour. Tier 2, Squad B notified first. SFCC-91 and SFCC-92 both need the same seam, so it's coming regardless.

**Two atoms only** — `zimmProductPrice` (the sole Figma component in scope, with Sale/Default variants) and `zimmProductProse` (the sanitiser boundary, because semgrep enforces it and it belongs in one auditable place). **Name, style code and model line are page markup.** No molecules, no organisms, no toolbar.

**The page composes.** No container mirroring `pdp/product-content`.

**Layout as Chakra props, not a recipe** — the recipe tier is scoped to variant/state on non-Chakra props, and a grid has no states.

**Model line reads `c_modelFit`** and renders nothing when absent. No scraping.

**Test shape follows #59** plus six named gap closures (G1–G6), the important one being a co-located test for data→props mapping, which `play` structurally cannot see.

**Breadcrumb is out** — handed to SFCC-578.

---

## What's owed by other people

**Integration:** the server-rendering finding, and the dependency ruling. **Squad B:** the `product-view` nod and breadcrumb ownership. **Jas:** the AC-versus-design conflict on the breadcrumb, and the three-instance duplicate-scope pattern. **The designer:** eight batched questions, including two genuine DS-versus-page inconsistencies (button 52 vs 50, style code one node vs two).

None of it blocks starting.

---

## Where I was wrong, and corrected

Fourteen times, and these are the ones that changed what we'd have built:

- **"Two shadowing mechanisms, deleting the route won't help."** One mechanism. The regression is a four-line fix, not a restructure.
- **"Move all eight `var()` sites into the recipe."** Three are correct as written — `theme.sizes` isn't registered, so a bare key on a sizing prop misresolves. Acting on that advice would have shipped a layout bug.
- **"The SSR crash is established."** Inferred, never reproduced. That's now Phase 0's hard gate.
- **"#59's test gates never ran."** They ran and passed on the last commit that touched source. The later skips are the allow-list working correctly.

# SFCC-89 — PDP static product information, built fresh

**Planned 2026-08-23.** Nothing built yet; no branch cut.

---

## Context

SFCC-89 ("PDP UI — static product information") already has an attempt on PR #57, by Jhoan. Its
component layer is good — `ZimmPdpProductInfo` is the best worked example of the house styling
pattern in the repo. Its integration layer is not: the page override takes over
`/product/:productId` and renders only a static panel, so **merging it removes add-to-bag, swatches,
the quantity picker, recommendations, accordions, SEO tags and 404 handling from the live PDP.**

That traces to one skipped step — the copy-first rule — which is also why its breadcrumb silently
restyled the PLP. Rebuilding correctly is cleaner than unpicking it.

Outcome wanted: SFCC-89's acceptance criteria delivered on top of an **untouched out-of-the-box
PDP**, with the genuinely shared pieces extracted as atoms that SFCC-91/92/194 can import.

---

## Decisions locked

| # | Decision |
|---|---|
| 1 | Branch **`feature/SFCC-89_pdp-static-product-info`**, cut from `develop` now, rebased when **PR #59** lands. |
| 2 | Clean build. #57 and SFCC-91 are read as reference so we don't build blindly — never copied from. |
| 3 | **Copy-first the PDP page.** Non-negotiable; its absence caused every integration defect in #57. |
| 4 | **`product-view` gets one override with a single optional `renderHeader` prop**, defaulting to the existing private header, so cart/wishlist/bonus-product are byte-identical unless they opt in. No speculative slots for SFCC-91/92. |

## What we build

Only two things earn their own file. A thing earns one when it has **its own reason to change** —
used in more than one place · has variants or states · owns a rule that must live in one place ·

Direct answer: **the plan says two** — `theme/components/zimmProductPrice.ts` and `theme/components/zimmProductProse.ts`, both `Zimm`-prefixed and registered in that folder's `index.ts`.

But your question made me re-check them against our own rule, and both are shakier than the plan claims.

**Decision 11 was "recipes only where a variant or state exists."**

`zimmProductPrice`'s variant axis is Sale/Default — and **Sale is SFCC-194's, not ours.** So in this ticket it ships with one state and no variants. By our own rule that's no recipe. And its other justifications don't survive scrutiny either: the PLP card doesn't reuse `pdp/price` (its price is a plain frame and text, not an instance), so there's no second consumer.

`zimmProductProse` is justified by owning the sanitiser rule. But the sanitiser itself is a **util** — `sanitiseHtml.ts` with real tests — and what's left in the component is one `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` line. If the model line turns out to be plain text via `c_modelFit`, that's one call site, not two.

**So the strictly consistent version of everything we decided is smaller again:** zero recipes, zero atoms — two utils with tests (`sanitiseHtml`, and a price formatter carrying the currency logic and the "which field is the full price" question), plus markup in the ported page.

That's the same reasoning that removed the toolbar and the product name. Applied honestly, it removes these too.

**The counter-arguments are real, though.** Keeping `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` inside one component is a better security posture than inline in a page — one place for semgrep to check and one place a reviewer looks. Price *will* get a Sale variant when SFCC-194 lands, and having the component there is cheap. And "atom-first" as a team direction argues for erring toward components rather than against.

I've now shrunk this build twice without flagging it as a pattern, so I'd rather you make this call than have me quietly shrink it a third time.

## What we're building

**Atoms** — `ui-kits/atoms/<camelCase>/`, each with `index.tsx` + `index.stories.tsx`:

| Atom | Spec | Recipe? |
|---|---|---|

| `zimmProductPrice` | `textStyle="price"` | **Yes** — `default` now, `sale` is the extension point SFCC-194 needs |
| `zimmProductDescription` | sanitised HTML, `textStyle="body2"` | **Yes** — responsive mobile inset |
| `zimmProductModelInfo` | `textStyle="caption"` | No — tier 1 covers it |
| `zimmProductStyleCode` | label + value, `textStyle="caption"` | **Yes** — multipart, since the DS models it as two nodes |

**Molecule** — `zimmProductContent`, composing name + price + description. That's not an invented grouping: it's the DS's own `Content` frame (218×82), with the 20px internal rhythm and the conditional margins in its recipe. Model info and style code stay outside it, because the design places them separately at the bottom after the accordions.

**Organism** — none. `pdp/hero` is the organism and it's SFCC-723's.

Four recipes, not six. `overrideStyling.md`'s hierarchy puts the recipe at **tier 3** for things needing variant, state or responsive behaviour; an atom whose whole spec is a `textStyle` plus a token is satisfied at tiers 1–2. That's also why #59 gave `zimmTextInput` and `zimmNavItem` recipes but not `zimmIcon` and `zimmLogo`.

## What we're overriding, and what each inherits

**`pages/product-detail/`** — copy-first port. Inherits `useProduct` with its nine-field `expand` list and `perPricebook: true`, `<Helmet>`/Seo, `HTTPNotFound` 404 handling, `Cache-Control: s-maxage=900`, and the Einstein/Data Cloud analytics beacons. All of which #57 lost by writing 48 lines from scratch against 876.

**`components/product-view/`** — scoped, one optional `renderHeader` prop defaulting to the existing private header. Inherits the add-to-cart wiring, swatch state, quantity state and the whole options column. Cart, wishlist and the bonus-product flow stay byte-identical.

## What we're reusing rather than rebuilding

`utils/safeHref.ts` and the recipe patterns from #59 · `recipeGuards.test.ts`, which auto-enforces the `Zimm` prefix · `iconSizes` and the foundation tokens as constants · base `Skeleton`/`Box`/`Text` from `shared/ui` · **base `app/components/seo`** — `react-helmet@6.1.0` is already installed, so SEO costs no new package · `proxyImageUrl` for anything touching images · `intl.formatNumber` for currency.

## How we style it

Recipe is the canonical surface for the four that need one, `Zimm`-prefixed and registered in `theme/components/index.ts`. `textStyle` for all type — never a raw `fontSize`. Semantic tokens for colour and space. `var(--zimm-scale-*)` where no named token exists, and on **sizing** props regardless, since `theme.sizes` isn't registered. Named consts with an owner comment for the genuinely unsourced values. No raw literals in component files.

## Build order

`sanitiseHtml` util with tests → the five atoms bottom-up → the molecule → the two overrides → integrate → verify.

Plan is consistent throughout now — five atoms, one molecule, four recipes, two overrides, one util.

**To answer your question directly: yes, four recipes.** `zimmProductPrice` (its `sale` variant is SFCC-194's extension point), `zimmProductDescription` (responsive mobile inset), `zimmProductStyleCode` (multipart — the DS models it as a label and a value), and `zimmProductContent` (the molecule's internal rhythm and conditional margins).

And the reuse and override principles are what shape the rest: we override the page and `product-view` specifically so we inherit the `expand` list, `perPricebook`, SEO, 404 handling, cache headers, analytics, add-to-cart wiring and swatch state — rather than rebuild any of it. That inversion is the whole difference from #57, which wrote 48 lines from scratch against an 876-line base and lost all of it.

# SFCC-89 — PDP static product information, built fresh

**Planned 2026-08-23.** Nothing built yet; no branch cut.

---

## Context

SFCC-89 ("PDP UI — static product information") already has an attempt on PR #57, by Jhoan. Its
component layer is good — `ZimmPdpProductInfo` is the best worked example of the house styling
pattern in the repo. Its integration layer is not: the page override takes over
`/product/:productId` and renders only a static panel, so **merging it removes add-to-bag, swatches,
the quantity picker, recommendations, accordions, SEO tags and 404 handling from the live PDP.**

That traces to one skipped step — the copy-first rule — which is also why its breadcrumb silently
restyled the PLP. Rebuilding correctly is cleaner than unpicking it.

Outcome wanted: SFCC-89's acceptance criteria delivered on top of an **untouched out-of-the-box
PDP**, with the genuinely shared pieces extracted as atoms that SFCC-91/92/194 can import.

---

## Decisions locked

| # | Decision |
|---|---|

## What we build

Structured by tier, per the team's approach: atoms compose into molecules, styling lives in theme
recipes, and we override rather than rebuild so we inherit existing wiring.

**Atoms** — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/<camelCase>/`, each `index.tsx` +
`index.stories.tsx`:

| Atom | Spec | Recipe? |
|---|---|---|
| `zimmProductName` | `textStyle="heading3"` | No — tiers 1–2 cover it |
| `zimmProductPrice` | `textStyle="price"` | **Yes** — `default` now; `sale` is the extension point SFCC-194 needs (`pdp/price` has both states) |
| `zimmProductDescription` | sanitised HTML, `textStyle="body2"` | **Yes** — responsive mobile inset |
| `zimmProductModelInfo` | `textStyle="caption"` | No — tiers 1–2 cover it |
| `zimmProductStyleCode` | label + value, `textStyle="caption"` | **Yes** — multipart; the DS models it as two nodes (label 57px at x=0, value 157px at x=61) |

**Molecule** — `zimmProductContent`: name + price + description. Not an invented grouping — it is
the DS's own `Content` frame (218×82). Its recipe carries the 20px internal rhythm and the
conditional margins that collapse when an optional field is absent.

**Model info and style code sit outside the molecule**, placed by the page, because the design puts
them at the bottom after the accordions rather than with the description.

**Organism** — none. `pdp/hero` is the organism and it is SFCC-723's.

**Four recipes, not six.** `overrideStyling.md`'s hierarchy puts the recipe at **tier 3** for values
needing variant, state or responsive behaviour; an atom whose whole spec is a `textStyle` plus a
token is satisfied at tiers 1–2. Same reason #59 gave `zimmTextInput` and `zimmNavItem` recipes but
not `zimmIcon` and `zimmLogo`.

**Overrides — what each inherits by overriding rather than rebuilding:**

| Override | Inherits |
|---|---|
| `pages/product-detail/` (copy-first port) | `useProduct` with its nine-field `expand` list and `perPricebook: true` · `<Helmet>`/Seo · `HTTPNotFound` 404 · `Cache-Control: s-maxage=900` · Einstein / Data Cloud / Active Data beacons |
| `components/product-view/` (one optional `renderHeader`) | add-to-cart wiring · swatch state · quantity state · the whole options column. Cart, wishlist and bonus-product stay byte-identical |

**Reuse rather than rebuild:** `utils/safeHref.ts` and the recipe patterns from #59 ·
`recipeGuards.test.ts` (auto-enforces the `Zimm` prefix) · `iconSizes` and foundation tokens as
constants · base `Skeleton`/`Box`/`Text` from `shared/ui` · base `app/components/seo`
(`react-helmet@6.1.0` already installed — no new package) · `proxyImageUrl` for image URLs ·
`intl.formatNumber` for currency.

**Styling approach:** recipe as the canonical surface for the four that need one, `Zimm`-prefixed and
registered in `theme/components/index.ts` · `textStyle` for all type, never a raw `fontSize` ·
semantic tokens for colour and space · `var(--zimm-scale-*)` where no named token exists and on
**sizing** props regardless, since `theme.sizes` is unregistered · named const + owner comment for
genuinely unsourced values · no raw literals in component files.

**Page layout values.** From `pdp/hero` Desktop Default (1440): gallery `list` x=0 w=**902**,
`pdp/product-content` x=**1082** w=**218** ⇒ gap **180**, right margin **140**.

| Value | Treatment |
|---|---|
| Column gap 180px | `var(--zimm-scale-4500)` — exact match, **not** a token gap |
| Desktop right pad 140px | `var(--zimm-scale-3500)` — exact match |
| Info column 218px | named const — no numeric alias for 218 |
| Mobile gutter 30px | import `grid.containerPadding.base` (exactly 30px; `grid` isn't a registered scale). **Not** the 32px `2xl` token. Confirmed by the mobile design: 342px column at x=30 in a 402 frame |
| Top padding 16px | bare key `m` |
| Gallery aspect ratio | plain ratio literal |

Note in the PR that **SFCC-723 (`pdp/hero`) should absorb these** into the hero organism.

## Test coverage requirements

#59's pattern is the basis and it is sound: move logic out into hooks, utils and exported recipe
resolvers, unit-test it there, let Storybook `play` drive the component. `AGENTS.md:151`,
`code-quality/SKILL.md:95` and `new-component/SKILL.md:50` all permit `.test.ts` **or** `play`, and
Storybook interaction + a11y are **required checks** on `develop`, so a play-only component is
genuinely gated. Its gates ran and passed on `a207b9a`, the last commit touching `overrides/`.

**Close these six gaps that #59 leaves:**

| # | Gap | What we do |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | Nothing ties external data shape to props. A mis-keyed field falls to `?? ''` and renders empty — invisible to `play` and to axe. `testing.md:19` ranks data mapping first. | A co-located test for the product→props mapping: every field, including absent, asserting the right field reached the right prop. |
| G2 | Nothing asserts a recipe's declared `parts` match what the component *reads*. Drift ⇒ `__css={undefined}` ⇒ silently unstyled. | Assert `parts` ⊇ the part names the component consumes. Comparing `parts` to `baseStyle` keys is insufficient — renaming both stays green. |
| G3 | Props crossing composition boundaries are unchecked. | Assert any prop crossing more than one boundary reaches the leaf. |
| G4 | Vacuity — suites asserting "no offenders" pass on empty input. Only `recipeGuards.test.ts` guards this. | Any such suite of ours carries a self-test proving it collected something. Copy `recipeGuards.test.ts:168-174`. |
| G5 | #59 asserts focus-trap behaviour in both a hook test and a `play`, against `testing.md:3`. | One layer per behaviour; note the choice. |
| G6 | A skipped required check satisfies branch protection. Correct when only docs/tooling changed; a hole when source changed. | Before requesting review, verify the gates ran on **the last commit that touched testable source**, not merely on head. |

Concretely: the **sanitiser util** and all four **recipes** get real Vitest files (resolver branches
where they exist, plus the G2 `parts` assertion) · the five **atoms** get stories, with a `play` only
where there's real behaviour or an a11y contract — no tautological `getByRole(); toBeInTheDocument()`
· the **molecule** gets a `play` covering the absent-optional-field cases · the **page's data
mapping** gets the G1 co-located test.
